C2 THE SAME QR AGAIN (a screenshot of it) → 409 pickup_already_verified: no second pickup
C3 THE PHONE NEVER POSTED A PICKUP: its POSTs were the cart, the pickup choice, the checkout, the payment and the channel authorization — no order status, no verification
C4 THE PHONE KEEPS NO CREDENTIAL: neither the QR secret nor the code is in the app's storage
D1 APP KILLED AND STARTED AGAIN on the order: the final state is read from the backend (GET /customer/orders/{number}) — COMPLETED, no pickup code
